# dependencies — Dependency management policy and manifests

## Authoritative implementation
- `pyproject.toml` — Python package `nexus-ai` v2.1.0: core deps, optional extras (`dev`, `ml`, `browser`, `vision`, `voice`, `gateway`), `[project.scripts]` `nexus` entry point
- `uv.lock` — uv lockfile pinning the Python environment (requires-python `>=3.14`)
- `package.json` — root convenience scripts only (`web:dev`, `tui:build`)
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — pnpm workspace declaring `apps/web` and `apps/tui`

## Why this directory exists
This is the approved home for dependency management. Policy: Python deps are declared in `pyproject.toml` and pinned in `uv.lock`; Node deps are declared in each app's own `package.json` (`apps/web`, `apps/tui`) and linked via the pnpm workspace.

## Notes
`pnpm-lock.yaml` is intentionally not committed — it is regenerated by pnpm on first install. Install with `uv sync` (or `pip install -e .`) and `pnpm --dir apps/web install` / `pnpm --dir apps/tui install`.
